course_outline_concepts: NaN/Inf root causes: softmax overflow, log(0) in KL, /0 in advantage normalisation
Loss divergence vs loss spike vs loss plateau — diagnostic trees
Dead data pipeline: upstream filter emits empty batches, trainer silently trains on padding
Masking bugs: prompt masking off-by-one, cross-sample attention leakage under packing
Distributed hangs: NCCL timeout, all-reduce rank drop, debugging with py-spy / gdb attach

sources.what_to_extract: pre_clip_grad_norm as earliest spike signal; 100x spike predicts loss spike 1-5 steps ahead; FSDP global-norm pitfall; unscale-before-clip ordering bug.
fp16 underflow / overflow mechanics; dynamic loss scaling and scaler drop-on-resume; why bf16 eliminates most numerical spikes; softmax/CE in fp32 invariant.
v_hat underflow with small grads; eps placement under fp16; beta_2 = 0.95 memory window; division-by-zero in optimizer step.
label[:prompt_len] = -100 off-by-one when the shift-for-next-token is forgotten; multi-turn mask of prior assistant turns; per-subsequence mask inside packs.
cu_seqlens varlen API; cross-sample attention leakage when the block-diagonal mask is missing; position_ids reset per sub-sequence.
AllGather + ReduceScatter per transformer block; HYBRID_SHARD pattern; why a single rank dropping its collective hangs the whole world group.
overfit-a-single-batch; initial-loss == ln(V); paranoia about model.train vs model.eval; neural net training fails silently as the organizing maxim.
OLMo 1 spike phenotype and the OLMo 2 three-layer mitigation stack (clip 1.0, skip-step, embedding-norm monitoring); Z-loss + QK-Norm as logit-overflow prevention.
1024-H100 pretraining scale; staged model flow means failures compound across stage boundaries; Olmo-core vs Open Instruct 8x throughput swap hides silent-mask bugs.
15.6T-token pretraining at 3.8e25 FLOPs scale; DPO NLL stabilizer as a chosen-logprob-collapse fix; preference-data noise and multi-turn drift as documented silent-failure classes.

entropy-collapse triage: KL term on/off, bump rollout temperature 0.1-0.2, raise entropy coef an order, advantage normalization per-batch zero-mean unit-var; NaN in PPO ratio -> lower LR and clip range.
sudden inflection from ~2-3 nats to <0.1 nats as collapse fingerprint; entropy coef interacts with advantage-norm and LR; collapse vs convergence distinction.
